name: Guabiruba (Brazil)
description: Horizontal triband of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Guabiruba is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 10 May 1977 (prescribed by Municipal Law No. 7 of 10 May 1977, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a winged helmet, a hoe and a chequered quarter, over a scroll reading 10-6 GUABIRUBA 1962
